description: This file defines a UI component class 'NotificationsSettings' for managing notification settings in a web application, including methods for expanding sections, verifying visibility, and interacting with notification options.

classes.name: NotificationsSettings
classes.description: A class representing the notifications settings UI component, providing methods to interact with notification options and sections.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the notifications settings container is visible.

methods.name: expandSection
methods.description: Expands a specific notification settings section, e.g., 'keysWithHighlight'.

methods.name: verifySectionIsExpanded
methods.description: Verifies that a specific section is expanded and its content is visible.

methods.name: getKeywordsInput
methods.description: Returns the input element for keywords, ensuring it is visible.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Clicks the 'Save' button to save notification settings.

calls: this.container.getByText('Enter non case-sensitive keywords, press Tab or use commas to separate them:')
this.container.getByText('These keywords will be shown to you with a highlight when anyone sends a message that includes them.')
